best_idea: A bounded record of recent rejected actions per player that refuses input and logs once when it locks, instead of logging every refused attempt.
decision_why: The counting, bounded record and log-once rule are useful anti-cheat telemetry for the input path. The donor's login lock is not copied as a player rule: a fight lock must be short, visible and never hide a kill. Donor defects (wrong-key touch, unlocked read-modify-write) are fixed in the sketch.
acceptance: A server test sends five rejected engage commands from one player; the fifth returns the lock reason; a sixth is refused with no new record or log line; after the lock time a valid engage passes; exactly one lock line is logged for the episode.
